name: Scam victim
description: What the person being scammed says: going along, doubt, stalling, verifying and giving details away. Pair it with the caller pack.

detectors.name: Uncertainty
detectors.what: the speaker expresses uncertainty, hedges, or says they are not sure
detectors.example: I'm not sure, maybe it was Tuesday.

detectors.name: Question
detectors.what: the speaker asks a question or asks for information
detectors.example: Where did you buy the code?

detectors.name: Goes along
detectors.what: the speaker agrees to do what the caller asks

detectors.name: Doubts the caller
detectors.what: the speaker questions whether the caller is genuine
detectors.example: How do I know you're really from the bank?

detectors.name: Plans to verify
detectors.what: the speaker says they will check independently, such as calling back on an official number
detectors.example: I'll call the bank myself on the number on my card.

detectors.name: Stalls
detectors.what: the speaker delays or says they need time before doing what is asked
detectors.example: Let me think about it first.

detectors.name: Shares sensitive details
detectors.what: the speaker reads out or agrees to share a code, password or account detail
detectors.example: The code is four, two, nine, one.
